name: Arcane Weapon
description: You imbue a weapon you touch with magical energy. For the duration, the weapon deals an additional 1d4 force damage on each hit and glows with faint magical light.
effect: Your weapon crackles with arcane force: +1d4 force damage on every weapon hit for 10 rounds (concentration).
notes: In combat: +1d4 force damage on every weapon hit for 10 rounds. Concentration.
